resolutions.title: recombination-factor ambiguity (EQ-02)
resolutions.v1_defect: EQ-02 removes (gamma_k / 2) (1/4) n_k vbar_k A_wall atoms per second while NP-ICP-CHEM-AIR AIR-WALL-02 / -03 define gamma as the per-collision recombination probability (O + wall -> 1/2 O2); with gamma in [0, 1] the literal v1 form cannot reach the physical maximum (verification_report_v1 PF-01).
basis: registered physical source: the coefficient's definition is owned by NP-ICP-CHEM-AIR (AIR-WALL-02 / -03: per-collision probability) and the wall impingement rate (1/4) n vbar A is Chiggiato 2014 sec. 2.1 (registered)
conservation: nuclei balance of the recombination stoichiometry X + wall -> 1/2 X2
dimensional consistency: gamma dimensionless in [0, 1]; (1/4) n vbar A [s^-1]
resolutions.v2_rule: EQ-02 v2: atom sink at wall surface j = gamma_k,m(j) (1/4) n_k vbar_k A_j [atoms/s]; molecule source = 1/2 of the sum over j (element-exact). gamma per (atomic species, wall material m) per IN-18 v2: a sourced value with its uncertainty, or the unweighted physical-bound vertex set gamma in {0, 1} per (species, material) (A9.31 OQ-CHEM-09 '[0,1] envelopes'). The recombination energy D0(X2) per molecule formed (1/2 D0 per atom recombined) is released at j: fraction beta (AIR-WALL-04; sourced or vertex {0, 1}) to the surface (W_j, Q_icp_plasma_wall_W), 1 - beta to energy class N (ED-01).
resolutions.status_effect: v1 withholding PREREG_FINDING_PF-01_EQ02_ATOM_RECOMBINATION_FACTOR is retired: gamma > 0 is evaluable in FLOW_BALANCE, each gamma vertex as its own scenario member (ED-08).
resolutions.model_form_note: the uniform-density wall flux (1/4) n vbar A at large gamma is a 0-D model-form assumption (MF-04); a depletion-corrected form recalled from memory is not used (VER-19)

resolutions.title: background inflow without residence / conductance basis (EQ-02)
resolutions.v1_defect: background inflow Gamma_bg = (1/4) n_b vbar_b sum_j A_open,j carries no transmission probability while effusion carries A_open,j tau_j; for tau < 1 the no-plasma, no-feed equilibrium is n = n_b (vbar_b / vbar) / tau instead of the reciprocity value (verification_report_v1 PF-02).
basis: registered physical source: Chiggiato 2014 Eq. 13 / Eqs. 19-21 (registered): the net molecular-flow throughput of a passage is Q = C (p_up - p_down) with C = C' A tau, so the same tau multiplies the flux in each direction
conservation / equilibrium: with no plasma, no feed and T_b = T_g the net flow through every open end must vanish at n = n_b (detailed balance); only the tau-symmetric form satisfies it
resolutions.v2_rule: EQ-02 v2: Gamma_bg,k = sum over open ends j of (1/4) n_b,k vbar_b,k A_open,j tau_j, with vbar_b,k at the registered T_b. Applies only to a registered isotropic Maxwellian background (bench: VI-GAS-05 p_b, T_b measured). If T_b differs from T_g beyond their combined registered uncertainty the case carries flag NON_ISOTHERMAL_PASSAGE and that path is gated by VER-20 (reciprocity of the transmission probability in a non-isothermal passage). A directed (hyperthermal) flight ambient flux is not this form: flight background needs a registered exposure model, else INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (DOM-17).
resolutions.status_effect: v1 withholding PREREG_FINDING_PF-02_BACKGROUND_INFLOW_WITHOUT_TAU is retired; LC-12 checks the equilibrium.

resolutions.title: neutral-energy split (EQ-16)
resolutions.v1_defect: 'deposited on the walls ... or carried out with outflowing neutrals in proportion to their loss channels' gives no operational split for elastic, vibrational and rotational energy given to neutrals (verification_report_v1 GAP-01); withheld for every real gas.
basis: conservation: the energy given to neutrals is fully allocated to wall surfaces or open ends (no remainder)

explicit bounding branch: T_g is a registered input and the neutral energy balance is not solved, so the split (energy accommodation at each wall material, unsourced) cannot be identified; the unweighted vertex set {WALL[m] for each wall material m, OUT} is an outer bound containing every accommodation coefficient in [0, 1] and every geometry
0-D model form (registered EQ-02 / EQ-03): within one material, impingement is proportional to A_j; between open ends, exit is proportional to A_j tau_j
resolutions.v2_rule: Energy class N (ED-01) = elastic recoil + vibrational + rotational excitation energy + (1 - beta) recombination energy. Destination vertex set D_N = {WALL[m] for each registered wall material m} U {OUT} (ED-02, ED-04, ED-05). No 50/50 or other point split.
resolutions.status_effect: v1 withholding PREREG_GAP_EQ16_NEUTRAL_ENERGY_SPLIT is retired; the partition keys are emitted per scenario member and as the envelope.
resolutions.model_form_note: MF-01: T_g stays a registered input; the vertex set bounds the disposition without changing T_g.

resolutions.title: atom-formation-energy disposal (EQ-16 / EQ-18)
resolutions.v1_defect: atom formation and fragment energy need the atom loss channels; REGISTERED_PRESSURE has no atom balance and FLOW_BALANCE needed gamma (PF-01); the partition was withheld whenever dissociation or dissociative ionization is present.
basis: conservation: energy created in the volume as atom formation energy (registered D0, IN-25) is released at the surfaces where atoms recombine or carried out by effusing atoms
registered source: D0 per molecule from a registered source (IN-25); beta per AIR-WALL-04
explicit bounding branch: where no atom balance is solved (REGISTERED_PRESSURE) the release location is the outer vertex set {WALL[m], OUT}
resolutions.v2_rule: Energy class A (ED-01) = atom formation energy 1/2 D0(X2) per atom created, relative to the ground-state molecules of the delivered feed (EQ-18 v2). FLOW_BALANCE: determined by the solved atom balance of EQ-02 v2 for each gamma member (recombination at j -> beta to W_j, 1 - beta to class N; effused atoms -> per open end). REGISTERED_PRESSURE: vertex set D_A = {WALL[m]} U {OUT} (beta applies under WALL[m]). The excess E_r - Delta E_form of a dissociative channel (fragment kinetic / internal energy) is class X (ED-01), never class A. A molecule without a registered D0 makes the partition keys INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (naming IN-25); the solve and I_e,cap are unaffected.
resolutions.status_effect: v1 withholding PREREG_GAP_EQ18_ATOM_FORMATION_ENERGY_DISPOSAL is retired except for the IN-25 registration gate (FC-29).

resolutions.title: CARRIED_OUT partition (IN-23)
resolutions.v1_defect: the CARRIED_OUT disposition has no registered split between the open ends.
basis: registered model form: the neutral exit rate through open end j is the EQ-02 effusion term (1/4) n vbar A_j tau_j, so carried-out neutral-borne energy leaves through j in proportion to A_j tau_j when every tau_j is registered
explicit bounding branch: when any tau_j is unregistered, the end split is the vertex pair {OUT[UP], OUT[DOWN]}
resolutions.v2_rule: ED-05: OUT energy of any class is split over the open ends in proportion to A_j tau_j (flag UNIFORM_ISOTROPIC_NEUTRAL_EXIT, MF-03) when every tau_j is registered; otherwise the vertex pair OUT[UP] / OUT[DOWN]. Ion- and electron-borne energy through an open end is computed per end from its fluxes (unchanged).

resolutions.title: multi-species H-LIEB treatment (EQ-05 with EQ-08 / EQ-09)
resolutions.v1_defect: per-species sigma_i gives per-species h_j, while EQ-08 / EQ-09 define one h per surface; multi-ion H-LIEB with distinct sigma was withheld.
basis: dimensional consistency / definition: the ion-neutral collision probability per unit length over independent neutral targets is sum_k n_k sigma_s,k, so lambda_i,s = 1 / sum_k n_k sigma_s,k (reduces to the v1 1/(n_g sigma_i) for one neutral species)
conservation: quasi-neutrality at each sheath edge, n_e,j = sum_s Z_s n_i,s,j (EQ-03 principle), fixes the electron edge density once the ion edge densities are given

explicit bounding branch: the edge-to-centre ratio of each species in a multi-ion plasma is not identified by the registered single-ion source (Lieberman 2015 slides 38 / 44); h(lambda) is monotone increasing, so the common-h pair evaluated at min_s lambda_i,s and max_s lambda_i,s brackets every assignment whose effective lambda lies within the species range
resolutions.v2_rule: EQ-05 v2 / EQ-22: three unweighted solve members. H-MS: h_j,s from EQ-05 with lambda_i,s; ion flux h_j,s n_i,s u_B,s; electron edge density n_e,j = sum_s Z_s h_j,s n_i,s in EQ-08 / EQ-09 in place of h_j n_e. H-LO: common h_j = h(min_s lambda_i,s) for all species. H-HI: common h_j = h(max_s lambda_i,s). With one ion species, or equal lambda_i,s, the three members are identical to v1 H-LIEB. Flag MULTI_ION_H_ENVELOPE; no member is a nominal (FC-26). Sheath-edge speed per species stays EQ-04 (MF-02, VER-21).
resolutions.status_effect: v1 withholding PREREG_GAP_MULTISPECIES_H_LIEB is retired; H-LIEB still needs registered sigma (IN-17, CHG-06) and DOM-05.

resolutions.title: registered-table scan / CC-03 normalisation acknowledgement
resolutions.v1_defect: CC-03 'relative to max |I_j|' degenerates when every surface floats (all net currents are rounding noise); the v1 implementation normalised by the largest current component; INT-16 (scan end) was recorded for acknowledgement.
basis: dimensional / numerical consistency: the rounding error of a signed sum of currents scales with the magnitudes of the summed one-sided components, not with the net; this is the v1 TOL-SOLVE convention ('relative to its largest term')
resolutions.v2_rule: CC-03 v2: I_scale = max over surfaces j and components of e A_j max(sum_s Z_s Gamma_i,s,j, Gamma_e,j) (> 0 for any sustained state); |sum_j I_j| <= 1e-10 I_scale; every floating |I_j| <= 1e-10 I_scale; |I_production - sum_j e A_j sum_s Z_s Gamma_i,s,j| <= 1e-10 I_production. NOT_SUSTAINED (n_e = 0): every current is exactly 0. Tolerance value unchanged. IN-24 v2 adopts INT-16 (approved_interpretations).
resolutions.status_effect: acknowledged and registered; no output status changes

energy_disposition.purpose: operational form of EQ-16 v2 for every energy that is not computed per surface from charged-particle fluxes (PF-01, GAP-01, GAP-02, GAP-03, INT-17). Each class is allocated in full; no remainder; no point split where the physics does not identify one.

items.name: energy classes
items.rule: ION / ELEC: ion- and electron-borne energy at each surface and open end (L_j and ion formation energy F_j released where ions are neutralized; F at an open end leaves with the ions) - computed per surface, no disposition choice (wall energy terms VER-12 inherited). X: electronic excitation per channel; the excess E_r - Delta E_form of every channel whose products carry less formation energy than its header (dissociative excitation / ionization fragments); the INT-17 route excess. N: elastic recoil n_k k_m,k (3 m_e / M_k)(T_e - T_g) V e n_e; vibrational and rotational excitation; (1 - beta) of wall recombination energy. A: atom formation energy (1/2 D0 per atom created).

items.name: destinations
items.rule: RAD -> Q_icp_radiation_W (class X only). WALL[m] -> Q_icp_plasma_wall_W on the wall surfaces of material m (W_j). OUT -> Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W / Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W (ED-05). A surface registered as the electron sink receives its WALL share inside Q_icp_extraction_W (TK-09).

items.name: sourced dispositions
items.rule: A channel with a sourced disposition (VER-11 cleared for that state: RADIATED_OPTICALLY_THIN, WALL_QUENCHED or CARRIED_OUT, or a sourced branching) uses it. An UNRESOLVED channel takes the class-X vertex set {RAD} U {WALL[m]} U {OUT}. This widens the v1 pair ALL_RADIATED / ALL_WALL (and NP-ICP-CHEM-AIR AIR-EXC-12) by the CARRIED_OUT vertex, which is the quench-probability-0 limit of AIR-WALL-06 for a metastable: stricter, never weaker (addendum_02 consistency rule).

items.name: wall distribution
items.rule: Energy sent to WALL is distributed over wall surfaces in proportion to c_j A_j when the class coefficient c_j (gamma for class A recombination, quench probability for WALL_QUENCHED, energy accommodation for class N) is sourced for every wall surface; otherwise by the per-material vertex WALL[m] (all of it on the surfaces of material m, area-weighted inside m). Area weighting inside one material is exact under the registered 0-D uniform isotropic neutral distribution with a common coefficient (MF-03, flag AREA_WEIGHTED_WITHIN_MATERIAL). With one registered wall material the set has one WALL vertex.

items.name: open-end split
items.rule: OUT energy is split over the open ends in proportion to A_j tau_j when every tau_j is registered (EQ-02 effusion terms; flag UNIFORM_ISOTROPIC_NEUTRAL_EXIT); otherwise by the vertex pair OUT[UP] / OUT[DOWN].

items.name: class A in FLOW_BALANCE
items.rule: Allocated by the solved atom balance of each gamma member: recombination at surface j -> beta to W_j, 1 - beta to class N; effused atoms -> their formation energy leaves through each open end with the computed effusion rate. No vertex choice is needed for class A in FLOW_BALANCE.

items.name: class A in REGISTERED_PRESSURE
items.rule: No atom balance is solved; class A takes the vertex set {WALL[m]} U {OUT}; under WALL[m], beta in {0, 1} (or sourced) sends 1 - beta to class N.

items.name: scenario members
items.rule: Solve members = chemistry variants (UQ-02) x unsourced gamma vertices per (atomic species, wall material) in FLOW_BALANCE x {H-MS, H-LO, H-HI} for multi-ion H-LIEB. Partition members (post-processing of one solve) = destination vertex of class X x of class N x of class A (REGISTERED_PRESSURE) x beta vertices x end-split vertices. Members are unweighted, never averaged, never narrowed; every output carries scenario_member_id; the envelope over members is OUT-13 scenario_envelope. Each member closes exactly (CC-05 v2, CC-08). Keys are linear in the class allocations, so for each key and each receiver the extreme loads are attained on these vertex members; the producer emits every member and flags, for every key and every IN-10 node, the members with the extreme load (consumer-registered partitions such as f_rad and f_up are applied by the consumer).

items.name: fragment kinetic energy
items.rule: NP-ICP-CHEM-AIR AIR-NL-01 keeps all neutrals at T_g in the particle balance; the energy the electrons lose to fragments (class X excess) is allocated by ED-03, never dropped.

model_form_limitations.text: T_g is a registered input; the neutral energy balance is not solved. The class-N vertex set bounds where the energy goes without changing T_g.
Each ion species enters its sheath at its own Bohm speed (EQ-04); multi-ion sheath-edge speeds are a model-form assumption (VER-21).
Uniform, isotropic neutral distribution of the 0-D model: the basis of area weighting inside one material and of the A_j tau_j exit split.
Uniform-density wall flux (1/4) n vbar A at any gamma (VER-19).
CPL-HALL-ON: current-free plume and the registered cathode-common topology (CPL-HON-03).

equations.name: neutral particle balance, FLOW_BALANCE mode (v2: PF-01, PF-02, OQ-NPICP-14)
equations.form: 0 = Gamma_in,k + sum_{open j} (1/4) n_b,k vbar_b,k A_open,j tau_j + V sum_r nu_r,k R_r + sum_{wall j} sum_s w_s,k Gamma_i,s,j A_j - sum_{open j} (1/4) n_k vbar_k A_open,j tau_j - sum_{wall j} gamma_k,m(j) (1/4) n_k vbar_k A_j + (1/2) sum_{a -> k} sum_{wall j} gamma_a,m(j) (1/4) n_a vbar_a A_j

equations.name: energy partition definitions and closures (v2)
equations.form: RF-S: P_icp_rf_source_DC_W = Q_icp_rf_conversion_loss_W + P_icp_rf_forward_W. RF: P_icp_rf_forward_W = P_icp_rf_reflected_W + Q_icp_line_W + Q_icp_match_W + Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W + P_icp_abs_W. PL: P_icp_abs_W = Q_icp_plasma_wall_W + Q_icp_extraction_W + Q_icp_radiation_W + Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W + Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W. B: P_icp_collector_bias_W = Q_icp_bias_collector_W + Q_icp_bias_export_W. S: P_icp_slot_load_sum_W = P_icp_rf_source_DC_W + P_icp_matching_DC_W + P_icp_collector_bias_W (+ installed variants). Per surface j: Q_j^kin = L_j + C_j exactly (sign convention SG-01); RF-powered surface deposit D_j = L_j + F_j + W_j; total surface heat Q_j = D_j + C_j.
equations.notes: Every term is computed from the converged state and the scenario member; none is a remainder. Q_icp_plasma_wall_W = sum over ICP-module wall surfaces of D_j; Q_icp_extraction_W = D_ec at the electron sink; outflow keys = D at the open ends (incl. ED-05 shares).
equations.source: energy conservation (CLAUDE.md rule 4); EQ-07 per-particle energies; A9.31 sec. 7

equations.name: formation-energy bookkeeping (v2: GAP-02, INT-17)
equations.form: Reference: ground-state neutral molecules of the delivered feed. E_form(atom of X2) = 1/2 D0(X2) (IN-25). E_form,ref(ion) = E_form(parent neutral) + least-energy registered ionization route (INT-17). Per event of reaction r: Delta E_form,r = sum products - sum reactants; route / fragment excess E_r - Delta E_form,r >= 0 (NP-ICP-CHEM-AIR FC-CHEM-03 guarantees the sign) is class X (ED-01). Ions neutralized at a surface release E_form,ref(ion) - E_form(neutral product) there (F_j; at the electron sink inside Q_icp_extraction_W, v1 INT-03 adopted); ions and atoms leaving through an open end carry their formation energy out.

items.name: current demand
items.rule: With the registered cathode-common topology and no other registered return path, Kirchhoff on the discharge loop gives the electron current the ICP must emit: I_e,emit = I_d (I_beam to the beam, I_d - I_beam into the channel); a registered extra path adds its registered current (MF-05).

items.name: extraction and coupling voltage
items.rule: The ICP solve (EQ-03..EQ-11, with HI-04 neutral inflow and HI-05 ion sources) runs with the extraction boundary at an unknown sink potential V_sink against the ICP reference; V_coupling_V is the root of I_e,extracted(V_sink) = I_e,emit. The extraction-boundary law is VER-24: until it is cleared, only the saturation bound I_e,ext <= (1/4) e n_e,edge vbar_e A_ext (EQ-09 / EQ-11, EQ-22; saturation branch VER-06) is reported as I_e_neutralization_available_A (an upper bound, VC-02 semantics) and V_coupling_V is NOT_EVALUATED; if I_e,emit exceeds that bound the raw state is DEMAND_ABOVE_EXTRACTION_UPPER_BOUND (a physics fact, never a verdict).

items.name: Hall-side feedback
items.rule: V_coupling changes the Hall operating point; the system orchestrator owns the Hall <-> ICP fixed point (|Delta V_coupling| <= 1e-6 V and relative current balance <= 1e-10, at most 100 iterations, else MODEL_ERROR; numerical policy). Until VER-23 shows how the pinned HallThruster.jl takes the coupling potential (or the map carries it as an axis), coupled outputs are INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (HALL_COUPLING_POTENTIAL_INPUT_UNVERIFIED).

items.name: neutral source
items.rule: G-REUSE in flight: the ICP neutral inflow is the Hall exhaust neutral flux transferred by an admitted model (HI-04); no inflow fraction is assumed.

items.name: beam and CEX ions
items.rule: Hall-produced ions reaching ICP surfaces enter EQ-10 as additional ion current at those surfaces; their arrival kinetic energy is Hall-powered (IF-HALL-THERMAL HK-09); their sheath energy (phi_p - V_j) at the surface is electrode-circuit energy (CPL-HON-08).

items.name: energy attribution
items.rule: In Hall-ON the electrode circuit is powered jointly by the ICP bias supply and the Hall discharge loop. The per-surface split of C_j between the two supplies is not identifiable (with sum_j I_j = 0, any reassignment of phi_p sum_{j in S} I_j between supplies conserves energy), so no per-surface supply split is made. The contract reports the supply terminal energies P_icp_collector_bias_W (= -sum over bias electrodes I_j V_j, slot icp_collector_bias) and P_cpl_hall_loop_at_icp_W (= -I_sink V_sink, inside the Hall discharge slot power) and the jointly powered deposition in coupling keys Q_cpl_hallon_circuit_by_surface_W (C_j at ICP surfaces, signed) and Q_cpl_hallon_circuit_export_W (C_sink, EXPORT), with P_icp_collector_bias_W + P_cpl_hall_loop_at_icp_W = sum of the two (<= 1e-10). These keys are never inside an IF-ICP-THERMAL-v2 key (FC-16 v2). Before execution a matched consumer version registers them once, with IF-HALL-THERMAL HK-08 defined so that the same C_j is never carried twice, and CONS-L1 compares them with a joint account of hall_discharge and icp_collector_bias at their load planes.

items.name: outputs
items.rule: I_e_neutralization_available_A (bound or value with status), V_coupling_V, I_d and I_beam echoed with the member id, the CPL-HON-08 energies; the pair (I_e, I_d) goes to assessment; no ratio is formed here.

items.rule: No beam divergence, plume potential, transfer fraction, coupling voltage or CEX parameter is defaulted; each comes from an admitted producer or a registered measurement.
